name: Anthropic
notes: Private (IPO registration pending). Figures from Anthropic's public Form S-1 (filed 2026-10-26) and S-1/A No. 1 (2026-11-02) on SEC EDGAR: revenue and operating loss as printed in the Summary Consolidated Statements of Operations Data (USD millions), earlier relayed through Reuters' review of the confidential prospectus. Calendar-year FY. GAAP net loss is far larger (2023: $1,531M; 2024: $8,309M; 2025: $41,965M, mainly non-cash fair-value changes of convertible notes and SAFEs, $34.3B in 2025) and is NOT used. Quality kept 'estimated' because the registration statement is not yet effective and the figures are unaudited-in-this-dataset context (not an annual report).
